dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing of the visible 2D body plane from the wide mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: The lateral margins appear smooth and exhibit no significant asymmetrical bulges or indentations relative to the axial center.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high median pixel intensity across the entire visible dorsal surface with minimal grayscale variance.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Sharp gradient slope at the lateral edges where the depigmented dorsal skin meets the dark water background.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, dark, thin longitudinal line is visible along the central dorsal axis in the posterior section.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Visible longitudinal shadow-casting depression or linear indentation along the posterior dorsal midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a distinct, dark linear marking or healed scar running longitudinally along the center of the posterior dorsal area.
